title: Double Poisson brackets on low dimensional algebras
summary: In this paper, we describe double Poisson brackets in the sense of M. Van den Bergh on certain finite-dimensional algebras. In particular we prove that all possible double Poisson brackets on matrix algebras are "inner", i.e. given by some commutators in bimodules. As a corollary of this result, we see that all possible double Poisson brackets in any finite-dimensional semisimple algebras over algebraically closed fields are also given by inner derivations.
